label: Guard rules a thread cannot read
means: Guard rules (no push to the default branch, no key printed or committed) that CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md leave unsaid.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, claude-projects (read 2026-11-26): a cloud thread loads each repo's CLAUDE.md but not its settings.json permission rules or hooks, so a guard must be said where the thread reads it; template goal: none missing
source: each params.rules pattern matched against the instruction files (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

params.comment: instruction_files: the files a cloud thread loads. rules: { label, pattern } pairs, each a case-insensitive regular expression. agent_dirs: folders of subagent files. hook_files: the settings and plugin files whose hooks code-project-hooks.mjs reads. unsafe_hooks: { label, pattern } pairs, a hook command that matches one is unsafe. repo: owner/name, empty for this repo. branch_prefix, window_days, max_prs: which merged pull requests count as thread work.

rules.label: Never push to the default branch
Never print or commit a key

unsafe_hooks.label: A download piped to a shell

label: Longest instruction file
means: Lines in the longest of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Every thread loads both.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, memory (read 2026-11-26): target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file, since longer files use more context and reduce adherence
source: line count of each instruction file (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

label: Read-only subagents that can edit
means: Read-only subagent files that list a writing tool, or list no tools and deny none, so inherit every one.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, sub-agents (read 2026-11-26): a subagent inherits every tool unless its definition lists them or denies some in disallowedTools; template goal: a read-only agent lists only reading tools
source: front matter tools of each agent file whose text says read only (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no agent files

label: First commit to pull request
means: Median minutes from a claude/ branch's first commit to its pull request, over the last 30 days of merges.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a thread opens its draft pull request within 10 minutes so CI starts early; DORA, Working in small batches (dora.dev/capabilities/working-in-small-batches, read 2026-11-25)
source: gh api repos/<repo>/pulls and each pull request's first commit (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no merged claude/ pull request

label: Pull request open to merge
means: Median hours a claude/ pull request stays open before it merges, over the last 30 days.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a green pull request merges within a day; DORA, Working in small batches (dora.dev/capabilities/working-in-small-batches, read 2026-11-25)
source: created_at and merged_at of merged claude/ pull requests, gh api repos/<repo>/pulls (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs)

label: Subagents with no model
means: Subagent files that name no model, so each runs on the parent thread's model.
goal_source: Claude Code docs, sub-agents (read 2026-11-26): a subagent runs on the same model as the conversation that starts it unless its definition sets one, and routing tasks to lower-cost models like Haiku controls costs
source: front matter model of each agent file (collectors/code-project/code-project.mjs); not measured with no agent files

label: API requests per read
means: gh api requests one read of the thread metrics spends.
goal_source: template goal: one pull request list and one commit read per pull request, ten at most, a small share of the workflow token's 1,000 requests an hour (GitHub Docs, Rate limits for the REST API, read 2026-11-19)

params.comment: weeks: how many 7-day buckets tokens_per_merged_pr compares. idle_minutes: the project cache lifetime, one hour. projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts; a ~/ path is under home. project_match: names no path here, the default is the repo's own project folder. subagents_dir: the folder of a session's subagent transcripts. human_origin: the origin kind of a record a person typed. repo, branch_prefix and window_days are set on the first target.

label: Thread PRs opened as drafts
means: Merged pull requests from claude/ branches that were drafts when opened, so CI runs before a person reads them.
goal_source: goal from the Projects docs: the example project instructions say "Branch from main and open one draft pull request per thread" (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, Write project instructions, read 2026-11-26), so every thread's PR starts as a draft
source: gh api graphql: the merged pullRequests of the last params.window_days (30) days whose branch starts with params.branch_prefix, up to the latest 100 by update; a PR counts as opened as a draft when its first ready-for-review or convert-to-draft event is ready-for-review (state, N = 100 PRs at most) (collectors/code-project/code-project-threads.mjs)

label: Sessions revived after an idle hour
means: Sessions that a person resumed after more than an hour idle, so the whole conversation was read again.
goal_source: goal from the Projects docs: the cache lifetime is an hour on Pro, Max and Ultra, and a thread idle longer than that re-reads its whole conversation when a follow-up reaches it, so new work starts a fresh thread (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, See and reduce a project's usage, read 2026-11-26); the docs give no count, so one a week is a template choice
source: the last 7 days of this repo's session transcripts, main sessions only: a record a person typed (params.human_origin) more than params.idle_minutes (60) after the session's previous record; N = 7 days (collectors/code-project/code-project-threads.mjs)

label: Tokens per merged thread PR, 4-week change
means: How much the tokens spent per merged claude/ pull request rose or fell from the oldest week to the latest.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the Projects docs say a project uses plan limits faster than one session and show usage by thread (code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects, See and reduce a project's usage, read 2026-11-26), so the cost of a merged PR falls or holds, never rises; zero change is the goal
source: params.weeks (4) buckets of 7 days: billable tokens (input, output and cache write, one count per message id, cache reads left out) of this repo's session transcripts, subagents included, divided by the merged PRs from params.branch_prefix branches of the same week (gh api graphql, up to the latest 100 by update); the change from the oldest bucket with both to the latest; N = 4 weeks (collectors/code-project/code-project-threads.mjs)

params.comment: setup_checks: { label, and one of file, dir, json or pattern }. part_rules: one entry per rule metric, { files, rules: [{ label, pattern }] }, each pattern a case-insensitive regular expression. settings_file and plugin_allow: the plugins a repo may turn on.
